title: LooK SPOT Antigen Rapid Test System
author: Diego Lai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bks6kwhe

steps.title: Install and register LooK SPOT app
steps.instruction: Download the LooK SPOT app from the app store, install it on an Android phone or iPhone with a video camera of more than 3 MP, and register the app together with the test location (SPOT) using contact information.

steps.title: Attach LooK SPOT reader to phone
steps.instruction: Mount the LooK SPOT reader onto the smartphone, align the phone camera with the reader lens, and tighten the rail with the wheel until the reader is securely fixed.

steps.title: Connect app to reader and calibrate
steps.instruction: Open the LooK SPOT app, connect to the attached reader via Bluetooth, and initiate the self‑calibration process, confirming the displayed “ok” indication before proceeding.

steps.title: Ensure patient has LooK PASS app
steps.instruction: Confirm that the patient has downloaded the LooK PASS app and completed registration with their contact information.

steps.title: Link antigen cassette to patient via QR
steps.instruction: Using the LooK PASS app, have the patient scan the QR code on the LooK COVID‑19 antigen cassette and associate the cassette ID with the patient’s ID.

steps.title: Collect nasal sample and extract buffer
steps.instruction: Take a nasal swab from the patient, place the swab into the tube containing the extraction buffer, stir the tube a few times, and wait exactly 00:01:00 (1 minute).

steps.title: Add sample drops to antigen cassette
steps.instruction: Using the provided dropper, extract liquid from the tube and apply three drops onto the sample window of the LooK antigen cassette.

steps.title: Insert cassette into reader and upload images
steps.instruction: Insert the prepared antigen cassette into the LooK SPOT reader; the reader will read the cassette ID and the app will begin sending images of the reaction to the LocationNow AI Cloud for analysis.

steps.title: AI analysis and result retrieval
steps.instruction: Allow the LocationNow AI cloud up to 00:05:00 (5 minutes) to analyze the color intensity of the reaction; the result is then returned to both the operator and the patient while preserving privacy.

steps.title: Generate Day Pass for negative result
steps.instruction: If the returned result is negative, automatically generate a Day Pass QR code containing a timestamp and location information, and permit the patient to enter the venue.

steps.title: Trigger alert for positive result
steps.instruction: If the result is positive, activate the privacy protocol that sends a real‑time alert to the CDC and relevant health agencies via API, while keeping the patient’s personal data protected.

steps.title: Discard used antigen cassette safely
steps.instruction: Remove the used antigen cassette from the reader and dispose of it according to biosafety guidelines.

steps.title: Sterilize reader with UV light
steps.instruction: Activate the interior UV light of the LooK SPOT reader for 00:00:10 (10 seconds) to self‑sterilize the device, making it ready for the next test.

steps.title: Upload patient and cassette data for validation
steps.instruction: Instantaneously upload the patient’s information together with the antigen cassette’s ID to the LocationNow AI cloud, where the legitimacy of both the cassette and the contact data is validated.
